decks.notes: This deck focuses on ramping up mana using Cloudpost and Tron lands to quickly cast high-cost, powerful colorless creatures like Ulamog, Emrakul, and Endurance. It also utilizes control elements such as Sowing Mycospawn and Disruptor Flute to disrupt opponents' strategies. The inclusion of cards like The One Ring and Kozilek's Command adds versatility and further control options. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its mana ramping capabilities and powerful threats, while also having answers to disrupt opposing strategies.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Broadside Bombardiers and Amped Raptor, supported by spells like Swords to Plowshares for removal. Containment Priest and Guide of Souls provide disruption and protection, while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah offers a powerful finisher. The deck also includes some mana fixing with lands like Cavern of Souls and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The goal is to maintain pressure on the opponent and close out the game before they can stabilize.

The main focus of this Legacy Aggro - Burn deck is to rapidly deal damage to the opponent through quick and efficient spells and creatures. By using cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel, Monastery Swiftspear, and Goblin Guide to pressure the opponent, alongside powerful burn spells such as Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Price of Progress, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize. Additionally, cards like Fireblast and Roiling Vortex provide additional burst damage and disruption to maintain the aggressive tempo.

The deck revolves around utilizing the Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor combo to mill through your library, while generating infinite copies of Narcomoeba. This combo allows for a quick win condition with Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Will and Teferi, Time Raveler, as well as removal with Prismatic Ending and Swords to Plowshares. The mana base is designed to support the combo pieces and ensure consistency in executing the win condition.

The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Nomads en-Kor, Cephalid Illusionist, and Dread Return to mill the library and win with Thassa's Oracle or Nadu, Winged Wisdom. It uses cards like Narcomoeba and memory's Journey to protect the combo and disrupt opponents with cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares. The deck also has tools like Brainstorm and Ponder for consistency and Urza's Saga for tutor potential. Other cards like Prismatic Ending and Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional utility and disruption.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill cards from your library in order to win the game with Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect the combo or deal with threats. The deck utilizes powerful card selection and manipulation tools like Brainstorm and Ponder to find key combo pieces quickly. Urza's Saga is included to search for essential artifact cards, while Teferi, Time Raveler can provide additional disruption and protection for the combo.

The main concept of this deck is to efficiently generate and utilize mana through artifacts, allowing for quick and powerful plays. Mystic Forge serves as a key combo piece, enabling the player to cast multiple spells from the top of their library. The deck also includes various artifact mana ramp cards like Grim Monolith and Voltaic Key, as well as artifact tutors like Karn, the Great Creator. The goal is to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to generate a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying evasive creatures like Ornithopter and Baleful Strix, while using Ninjas like Yuriko and Ingenious Infiltrator to deal damage and draw cards. It also includes disruption cards like Stifle and Force of Will to control the opponent's spells, while Retrofitter Foundry provides a way to generate additional creatures. The deck aims to apply pressure early in the game and maintain card advantage through the use of its creature abilities and card draw spells.

The deck revolves around using Painter's Servant and Grindstone to combo off and mill the opponent's entire deck. It utilizes cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Sai, Master Thopterist to generate value and fuel the combo. Urza's Saga helps to tutor for key pieces of the combo while Mox Opal and Lotus Petal help to ramp into the combo quickly. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Will and Metallic Rebuke to protect the combo. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo and win the game in a single turn.

The deck is focused on generating mana quickly and efficiently using cards like Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual, and Lion's Eye Diamond to cast a large number of spells in one turn. The goal is to assemble a powerful storm count and finish the game with a large Tendrils of Agony or Burning Wish for Ad Nauseam. The deck also includes protection in the form of Duress, Thoughtseize, and Veil of Summer to disrupt the opponent's game plan and ensure a successful combo turn. The inclusion of Wishclaw Talisman and Beseech the Mirror provides additional flexibility in finding key combo pieces.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently bring powerful creatures back from the graveyard to the battlefield, using cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead. By utilizing powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with threats that are difficult to deal with. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Force of Will and Thoughseize to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while also including disruptive lands like Wasteland.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Entomb and Reanimate. It also utilizes cards like Force of Will and Brainstorm to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The addition of Troll of Khazad-dûm and Orcish Bowmasters provides additional threats and utility. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while also including disruption in the form of Wasteland. Overall, the deck aims to quickly reanimate powerful creatures and overwhelm the opponent with its combo potential.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, and then bringing them back onto the battlefield for a huge advantage. The deck includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo, while also having some tempo plays with cards like Brazen Borrower and Daze. The key strategy is to out-value the opponent by reanimating high-impact creatures and controlling the game with disruption spells.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back into play for a strong advantage. The key strategy involves using cards like Entomb and Reanimate to cheat out big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. Utilizing cards like Brainstorm and Ponder help to find the necessary combo pieces quickly, while disruptive spells like Force of Will and Thoughtseize help to protect the combo. With a mix of control and reanimation, this deck looks to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures early in the game.
